name: The Construction of the L3 Experiment
notes: Preprint date (src:lep-inspire-detector-papers) is 1989-10; the journal issue is 1990.

summary.plain: The L3 collaboration's own full technical description of the finished detector.
summary.technical: Nucl. Instrum. Meth. A 289 (1990) 35-102 (report L3-000); the standard L3 detector-paper reference, describing the silicon-strip microvertex detector, time-expansion chamber, BGO electromagnetic calorimeter, hadron calorimeter, muon spectrometer and magnet.
